verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an official Cafe CLI (`cafe`). It handles browser-based sign-in, sets up Git credentials, and manages repositories, pull requests, stacks and issues from the terminal. For agents and scripts it adds `--json` structured output, a `--no-input` non-interactive mode, `--yes` confirmation and a `cafe api` passthrough. All of this comes from first-party docs only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: It signs you in, sets up Git credentials, and manages repositories, pull requests, stacks, issues and more from the terminal.
`--json` prints structured output; progress and errors go to stderr. `--no-input` fails instead of prompting; `--yes` confirms destructive actions.
`cafe api <path>` sends an authenticated request to any REST API endpoint.
Manage repositories, issues, and pull requests with the Cafe CLI.
`cafe stack submit` pushes each commit after the base as its own branch and opens or reuses one pull request per commit.
